name: Tragniew Park Compton Crips
description: The Tragniew Park Compton Crips (TPCC) are a primarily African-American street gang located on the West Side of Compton, California. Their territory runs from 154th Street to Alondra Boulevard, between Central Avenue and Clymar Avenue, centered around Tragniew Park on Central Avenue between Alondra Boulevard and 159th Street. They originated in the 1970s as the Tragniew Park Crips and have been active since the 1980s.
